_doc: Bowman first-job cards (#199), followed by Hunter (#202) and Crossbowman (#203) cards. Crossbowman ranks20/30/20/20/30; attacks learn/rank4/3 and passives/buff2/2; behaviour +1/max3/weight2, exact job320, held crossbow, shared rarities. Tier A: rank caps16/20/8/20/20/20. Tier C: attacks learn/rank weights4/3, other skills2/2; +1 shot per behaviour step, max3, weight2; shared Potential rarity magnitudes and held-weapon eligibility. First-job cards carry to310/320, but never displace their own advancement draws. Untuned.
